goal: The store schema and protocols shrink to ledger and OLTP only: sdk_messages, run_sequence, and the events category split are gone, along with the sdk-message and merged-audit store verbs.

constraints: Spec FR-5 is authoritative: drop sdk_messages and run_sequence from both schema files, make events domain-only (remove the category column and partial index, or rename the table -- record the choice in the schema header), bump CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, refuse older databases via StoreSchemaError

Remove append_sdk_message, save_sdk_messages, list_sdk_messages, and read_audit_since from the protocols, all three store implementations, and the _EventStreamingStore wrapper; sweep all remaining callers and tests with grep before committing
Domain-event ordering must remain strictly monotonic per run without the cross-table counter; replay (list_domain_events fold) must behave identically
Rewrite the schema header comments: the audit-stream description, the run_sequence paragraph, and the sensitivity note now extend to the .flywheel/logs directory
Store contract tests pin the removed verbs and the shared-sequence interleaving (spec 00010 FR-3) -- update them in the same commit
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: No control_commands or task_claims changes -- steering-ledger owns those
No forward migration of any kind
edge_cases: control_commands ordering relies on its own autoincrement id, not run_sequence -- it must be untouched by the counter removal
